context: cgo, GTK4, and testing a Wails v3 app on Linux CI

checklist.name: cgo_cause
checklist.description: Explains that pkg/application needs cgo on Linux (and macOS), so it does not compile with CGO_ENABLED=0.

checklist.name: no_v2_tag
checklist.description: Rejects the webkit2_41 suggestion as a Wails v2 tag that v3 does not use.

checklist.name: gtk4_packages
checklist.description: For the release build lists a C compiler, pkg-config, libgtk-4-dev, and libwebkitgtk-6.0-dev (or the GTK3 pair libgtk-3-dev and libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev with -tags gtk3), with CGO_ENABLED=1.

checklist.name: ci_strategy
checklist.description: Keeps CI free of GTK by testing Wails-free service packages, by building the entry point only with cgo, or by running the Wails tests with -tags server; or installs the GTK4 packages and enables cgo. Any of these counts when its trade-off is stated.

checklist.name: production_tag
checklist.description: Builds the release with -tags production (or wails3 build and the Taskfile), after building the frontend so index.html is embedded.
